svg.aria-label: How I Work. Integration: I make seperate subsystems work as one system. When I worked on my Tamagotchi-inspired habit tracker, the Synabond, I had several sensors and actuators talk to an ESP32 using various communication protocols while following two seperate state machines. Organization: I keep teams moving. This summer at Equitable I coordinated a roughly 30-person software team across UI, API, Batch, and project management through 4 sprints. I built AI agents and a Loop board that tracked 600+ leadership action items, and I stepped in as acting project manager for 1.5 weeks. Teaching: I like explaining things until they click. I worked with educators at a summer coding camp for 150+ students in Grades 6 to 10, designed a cryptography escape-room workshop, and trained the incoming project coordinator before my Equitable term ended.
